Hi Olivia — thanks, and great question set. I attached a short commercial summary and a draft SOW that maps to the three packaging options we typically propose for regulated customers (Pilot, Production, Multisite). High-level answers below and the attachments have line-item math.

Quick answers (summary):
- Platform fee (annual): $150k (Pilot), $350k (Production single-site), $650k (Multisite up to 3 sites). These include the control plane subscription, access to private patches, and 12 months of observability retention at standard levels.
- Operator licenses: $12k per operator (site-admin account) for on-prem operator tooling. We do not gate by token; we provide node-equivalent guidance in the worksheet for sizing.
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5, 24-hour response), Enhanced (24x7, 4-hour response, quarterly architecture reviews), Enterprise SRE (24x7, 1-hour critical, dedicated escalation SME, up to 120 hrs/year on-site/remote). Details in the summary.
- Accelerator credit: for regulated/airgapped installs we offer a one-time pilot credit that offsets up to 40% of the Pilot platform fee (applied as a credit on first invoice) in exchange for a 12-month committed conversion to Production if you proceed within 6 months. Alternatively, we can amortize the platform fee over 12 or 24 months; amortization reduces upfront cash but reduces the available accelerator credit by an equivalent amortized amount.
- Invoicing: we support upfront annual invoice or amortized monthly invoices via a 12/24 month invoice schedule. For amortization we require a purchase order and a signed SOW with milestone schedule.
- Security add-ons: audit-support bundles (SOC evidence collection, pen-test coordination) are billable at a fixed pass-through + engineering time. HSM/KMS integration assistance is typically a one-time professional services line item; costs depend on vendor.

Attached: PrivDeploy-SOW-draft.pdf, PrivDeploy-Pricing-worksheet.xlsx, PlatformFee-Amortization-example.xlsx

Next steps: if Medicon prefers an amortized plan + pilot credit, I suggest we route an SOW with the accelerator credit clause (two options in the SOW). Marissa (cc’d) is our commercial lead and can propose a final credit math and invoicing schedule. Would you be available for a 30-min pricing alignment Friday?

Thanks — Priyom

Hi Olivia — looping in a suggested commercial concession that has worked for similar regulated customers (one of the framework options we often use):

Option A (Conversion-backed accelerator):
- Pilot platform fee at list ($150k) with a 40% accelerator credit ($60k) applied to first invoice. Credit is conditional on signing a 12-month Production contract within 6 months of pilot completion.
- Production platform fee then billed at $350k annual; credit is one-time and not refundable.

Option B (Amortized cash-friendly):
- Reduce upfront Pilot invoice by amortizing 50% of the Pilot platform fee across 12 months (monthly invoices). Offer a smaller pilot credit (20%, $30k) that applies provided Medicon takes Production within 3 months.

Additional commercial notes:
- For air-gapped installs we typically include up to 40 hours of validation/provisioning assistance (PS time) as part of the accelerator; additional hours bill at our standard PS rate (see worksheet).
- SLA credits for downtime: standard response SLAs are included. We can provide an escalation SLA addendum for 24x7 SRE (Enterprise tier) with a financial credit schedule in extreme cases; that requires executive sign-off and is negotiated separately.

Recommend path: Option B (amortized) if Medicon is cash-sensitive during Q3 pilot validation, else Option A preserves larger credit but requires firm conversion commitment.

If you confirm which option you prefer I’ll prepare a SOW variant and an invoice schedule for procurement.

—Marissa
